name: extended
description: Adds software decoders for codecs Apple does not decode (legacy Pro formats, VP8/VP9). H.264 is never software-decoded: Hi10P is out of scope. VC-1 stays off until legal clearance (D-E8).

mpeg4.note: MPEG-4 Part 2 (Xvid/DivX); last patent reportedly expired 2026-07 (single source)

wma.note: Microsoft audio codec; check before enabling
